notes: Manufacturer spec sheet (Ashly KLR Series datasheet DS-0615) confirms: each of the 2 channels has balanced inputs available via combo XLR/1/4" TRS phone jack AND a 3-pin Euroblock terminal, all wired in parallel (redundant access to the same balanced input, not 3 independent channels). Outputs are 4-pin Neutrik speakON connectors, one per channel. Power cable connector is 3-prong NEMA 5-15 (factory set for 120VAC or 240VAC, 50-60Hz) via a permanently attached cord — modeled as nema-5-15 per the closest list match. No digital/bandwidth-graded connectors are present (fully analog balanced amp), so no grade field applies to any port. Dimensions 19"W x 3.5"H x 16"D, net weight 26.6-26.7 lbs (12 kg), 2RU rack-mount chassis. Also has front-panel attenuators and rear-panel gain/mode/HPF/limiter switches, which are not physical I/O connectors and were omitted.
